name: Murcia
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for
terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Spanish Vino de la Tierra in the Vino de la Tierra (IGP) category, covering Murcia, where Monastrell dominates, making up 76 percent of plantings.
